checks.content: A computer processes information through a complex, synchronized dance of hardware and software components, all orchestrated by the central processing unit (CPU). The processor is the brain of the computer, responsible for executing instructions and performing calculations. It operates by fetching instructions from memory, decoding them to understand what operation is required, and then executing that operation. This cycle, known as the fetch-decode-execute cycle, happens billions of times per second. The processor relies on registers, which are small, ultra-fast storage locations within the CPU itself, to hold data temporarily while it is being processed.
